economic_hypothesis: A stock-level signal observed at one completed intraday decision window and confirmed or contradicted at a later completed window distinguishes persistent information flow, resumption after pullback, and liquidity reversal.

factor_families.persistent_positive_path: previous ret1>0, current ret1>0, current ret3>0
factor_families.improving_positive_with_volume: current ret1 exceeds previous ret1 by 0.2%, current ret1>0, current volume acceleration>1
factor_families.positive_path_pullback_resume: previous ret3>0.8%, current ret1 between -0.5% and 0
factor_families.persistent_down_then_reclaim: previous ret1<0, current ret3<0, current ret1>0.15%
factor_families.prior_volume_lead_confirmation: previous volume acceleration>1.5, current ret1>0.3%, current ret3>0

hard_gates.native_factory_null: run only after all pre-null gates
